agreed_facts: For the quarter ended May 31, 2026, revenue increased 60% year over year to $8.222 million, net income increased 31% to $2.948 million, and EBITDA increased 29% to $4.685 million; both sides note these results match the supplied model rather than establish a forecast beat.
Water and wastewater revenue rose 119% to $4.659 million, deliveries increased to 631 acre-feet from 76, and water taps sold increased to 66 from 40.

Lot sales revenue increased 19% to $3.006 million. The company expects substantial completion of Phase 2D by fiscal 2026 year-end and approximately 159 Phase 2E lots in fiscal 2027, paced to builder absorption.
Cash and cash equivalents declined to $8.440 million from $21.931 million. The supplied evidence does not establish the cash-flow outlook or funding needs.
The supplied evidence does not test whether demand and timing kill criteria have been triggered, and does not establish the durability of the quarter's growth.

open_disagreements.topic: Whether the sharp increase in water activity indicates durable, broad-based demand or an unproven mix of demand sources
open_disagreements.bull: Higher water and wastewater revenue, deliveries, and tap sales support growth in both water demand and housing-related activity.
open_disagreements.bear: The figures do not quantify oil-and-gas's contribution or show that either source of demand will persist; the increase could be temporary or concentrated.
open_disagreements.what_would_resolve: The company's Form 10-Q for the quarter ended May 31, 2026, including segment and MD&A disclosures that separate oil-and-gas water sales from development-related water and tap revenue, followed by comparable disclosures in subsequent quarterly Forms 10-Q.

open_disagreements.topic: Whether the cash decline signals meaningful funding risk as development proceeds
open_disagreements.bull: Cash declined materially, but the supplied balance alone does not establish a funding shortfall; the bull treats it as a reason for caution rather than a forecast.
open_disagreements.bear: The decline warrants scrutiny of potential funding needs during Phase 2E construction.
open_disagreements.what_would_resolve: The May 31, 2026 Form 10-Q cash-flow statement and liquidity, capital-resources, and commitments disclosures, plus subsequent filings showing cash flows, construction spending, and any new borrowing or equity financing.

open_disagreements.topic: Whether Phase 2D and Phase 2E execution is on schedule relative to prior guidance
open_disagreements.bull: Current plans remain constructive: Phase 2D is expected to be substantially complete by fiscal year-end, and Phase 2E lots are to be paced to builder absorption.
open_disagreements.bear: Current guidance alone does not show whether timing has slipped or whether absorption will support the planned pace.
open_disagreements.what_would_resolve: The prior company earnings release or investor presentation stating the earlier Phase 2D and Phase 2E schedules, compared with the May 31, 2026 Form 10-Q and the next company earnings release for updated milestones and lot-delivery plans.

open_disagreements.topic: Whether lot and tap activity confirms sustained builder absorption or satisfies the stated demand kill test
open_disagreements.bull: Year-over-year growth in lot sales and taps is directionally supportive of conversion and absorption.
open_disagreements.bear: One quarter does not establish a sustained trend or resolve the criterion requiring two consecutive quarters of stalled taps alongside a greater-than-25% decline in county single-family permits.
open_disagreements.what_would_resolve: The next two quarterly company filings or earnings releases reporting comparable tap sales, together with the Arapahoe County single-family building-permit dataset for the corresponding year-over-year periods.

data.summary: The parties agree that reported results and water and tap activity grew year over year, while cash declined and the supplied figures do not establish a forecast beat or durable trend. They differ mainly in how much weight to give the operating growth versus unresolved questions about demand mix, execution, and funding; the specified filings and permit data can address those questions.
